notes.title: Update 6.1 18-05-2025
notes.notes:
Update 6.1 18-05-2025

Dear gamers,

After a while no news, some things have been changed in the game
We have removed Rebirth, because it takes a lot of time to build up your farm.
And we think it's a waste of time and a waste of game experience.
Instead of a Rebirth system, we have made a nicer alternative
Some benefits such as auto Play which makes playing much easier, available right from the start, does cost game money to elicit them.
And per pear it will cost you a lot of money, if you don't have money you can just click Manuel so your game will never fall dead.
Instead of Rebirth we have created a bonus system as soon as you have a certain amount of bonus points you get a bonus every time you have a bonus points you get another bonus.
These bonuses range from Cash bonuses to speed up bonuses or extra fields or animals.
Depending on what you have already elicited in the game.
These changes were made based on game testing. The testes wanted the auto Play to be available earlier, We looked at how we could achieve this.
We are happy with the results of the game 

The next update will come next week, we will continue this week with the new changes in the game so that everything works properly.
We hope to see you again at the next Update of :

IDLE Farm tycoon
